==Description==
'''D-140''' Is the sixth entity to appear in the D section. For more information, look below.

==Mechanic==
D-140 will spawn in front of the next door, making a high pitched version of a cockpit Announcement. After a few seconds, D-140 will rush backwards at a very fast speed. After around 40 seconds have passed, D-140 will come back to the current room and began to check blue heavy lockers or white cabinets back a couple rooms depending if you are in the lab or the mines. After checking, D-140 will rush back to despawn. Any player caught by D-140 will instantly get killed.

==Strategy & Tips==
*'''D-140''' Is loud so make sure to turn down your volume.
*[[D-55]] can't spawn while '''D-140''' is active, so don't hide in '''Blue lockers''' or '''White cabinets''' while '''D-140''' is active.
*If you're in '''Chaos mode''', '''D-140''' and [[A-135]]/[[A-135i]] can spawn with it, so in this case use '''Safe spots''' or '''Tables'''.
*Don't rush too much to avoid getting combo'ed or hide in a blue locker in emergency to avoid getting killed by [[D-60]] for example.
*'''D-140''' will not Rebound if [[D-5i]] or [[D-60]] is active, unless he's already Rebounding.
*If [[D-60i]] is active, '''D-140''' will not be able to spawn.
